title: 第286章 道在己身不在吾师第285章 己所不欲勿施于人
slug: 别人修仙我闲逛游历三界终长生
content_zh:
第286章道在己身，不在吾师
周德安微微颔首，道了声谢，便带着灵剑山众人踏入山门。
在崆峒山弟子的带领下，朝静舍走去。
一路上，有不少修士望了过来。
有人一眼认出灵剑山众人，当即主动上前拱手行礼道：
“在下青云宗弟子，见过诸位灵剑山仙长！”
“在下栖云谷，久仰灵剑山大名！”
“在下散修沐玄，有幸得见贵宗，拜见诸位仙友！”
周德安等人一一回礼道：
“见过诸位仙友。”
寒暄之间，一名青云宗长老带着满脸好奇与敬畏，开口问道：
“周长老，近日九州皆传贵宗掌门苍恒真人，已于东海白日飞升，位列真仙，此事可否属实？”
此话一出，周围所有人都瞬间安静了下来，目光齐齐望向周德安，想知道传闻是否属实。
周德安闻言，脸上满是笑意，点了点头道：
“确有此事。”
原来，敖曦瑶去找他弟敖渊，便将苍恒真人飞升的事告诉了他。
敖渊又派虾兵蟹将，将此事告知了灵剑山众人。
话音刚落，周围一片哗然。
“竟然是真的！”
“苍恒真人真的飞升了！”

“苍恒真人潜修千年，一朝得道，当真惊世骇俗！”
“我辈修士苦修一生，所求无非飞升大道，苍恒真人当真千古奇才！”
“恭喜灵剑山！”
“恭贺贵宗出此上仙！”
一时间，祝贺声此起彼伏，有拱手作揖的，有面带羡慕的。
周德安一一回礼，语气谦和道：
“多谢诸位仙友的祝贺，周某代掌门谢过诸位仙友了。”
也有人遗憾道：
“可惜苍恒真人忽然飞升，这届仙道盛会无缘得见真人登台讲道，实属我等憾事啊！”
“是啊，若能有幸听闻真人讲道，必定受益匪浅。”
周德安再次拱手，与众人寒暄了几句后，便带着灵剑山众人沿着石阶往山上走去。
行至山顶，周德安忽然停下了脚步。
不远处一座亭子中，他看到了几道熟悉的身影。
其中一道身影站在亭子前，朝这边挥手喊道：
content_en:
Chapter 286 The Tao belongs to you, not to my teacher
Zhou De'an nodded slightly, thanked him, and led everyone in Lingjian Mountain into the mountain gate.
Under the leadership of the Kongtong Mountain disciples, we walked towards Jingshe.
Along the way, many monks looked over.
Someone recognized the people in Lingjian Mountain at a glance, and immediately took the initiative to step forward, cupped his hands and saluted:
"I, a disciple of Qingyun Sect, have met all the Immortal Leaders of Lingjian Mountain!"
"In Xiayun Valley, I have admired the name of Lingjian Mountain for a long time!"
"I am a Sanxiong cultivator, Mu Xuan. I am honored to meet your noble sect and pay my respects to all my fellow immortals!"
Zhou De'an and others responded one by one:
"I've met all my fellow immortals."
During the greetings, an elder from the Qingyun Sect asked with curiosity and awe on his face:
"Elder Zhou, it has been recently spread across all nine states that the leader of your sect, Cang Heng, has ascended to the rank of true immortal in the East China Sea. Is this true?"
As soon as these words came out, everyone around him fell silent instantly, all looking at Zhou De'an, wondering if the rumors were true.
When Zhou De'an heard this, his face was full of smiles, he nodded and said:
"It's true."
It turned out that Ao Xiyao went to find his brother Ao Yuan and told him about the ascension of Master Cang Heng.
Ao Yuan sent shrimp soldiers and crab generals to inform everyone in Lingjian Mountain about the incident.
As soon as he finished speaking, there was an uproar around him.
"It's actually true!"
"Master Cang Heng has really ascended!"
"Master Cang Heng has been cultivating for thousands of years, and once he attains enlightenment, he will truly shock the world!"
"My monks have been practicing hard all their lives, and all they want is to ascend to the great road. Master Cang Heng is truly a genius through the ages!"
"Congratulations to Lingjian Mountain!"
"Congratulations to your sect for becoming an immortal!"
For a while, congratulations came one after another, some bowed their hands, and some looked envious.
Zhou De'an returned the greetings one by one and said in a humble tone:
"Thank you all my fellow immortals for your congratulations. Sect Master Zhou has thanked you all."
Others regretted:
"It's a pity that Master Cang Heng suddenly ascended to the throne. It's a pity that we didn't get to see him preach on stage at this grand event of immortality!"
"Yes, if you are lucky enough to hear a real person preach, you will definitely benefit a lot."
Zhou De'an held up his hands again, and after chatting with everyone for a few words, he led everyone in Lingjian Mountain up the stone steps.
When they reached the top of the mountain, Zhou De'an suddenly stopped.
In a pavilion not far away, he saw several familiar figures.
One of the figures stood in front of the pavilion, waved this way and shouted:
